variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: A governing party has left the colony's government. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
